Every single one of the 32 sprites must preserve the EXACT source pose, direction (faces LEFT), proportions, position within its cell, wheel centers, gun angle, animation variation, and amount of surrounding empty space. Keep the original small dark blue wheeled artillery chassis with black rubber chunky tires, golden wheel hubs, blue elevated pivoting gun with silver barrel, orange rear lamp. Do not invent a tank, tracks, robot, or character. Improve clarity of edges, blue paint, metal highlights, tire tread and golden hubs while closely matching the nostalgic painted cartoon look. Row1 idle; row2 original muzzle flash poses; row3 first charge; row4 second charge; row5 recoil gun rising; row6 special recoil; row7 damage recoil tilted chassis; row8 broken dark wreck exactly as source. Preserve all source yellow muzzle flashes in row2. Keep sprites confined to exact corresponding cells, NO overlap across cells, NO grid lines, NO labels, NO text, NO floor, NO cast shadow, genuinely transparent empty space. Preserve empty padding and ground baseline. Do NOT enlarge the object relative to its cell. ONLY upgrade the artwork fidelity, not redesign. The last 2 references show the rider, but DO NOT include this rider in this vehicle sheet: rider is a separate game layer.
